title: Complete binary spectator padding with a depth-independent volume bound
head: 0362534712dca8639917a733be62840d5ce55978
body:
PR2399 explicitly requires an extra adapter when the earlier completed binary callee only promises binary-complete spectators. This contribution coalesces the prefix, gap and suffix before padding, proving arbitrary complete spectator ranges cost less than eight times the original volume, or less than 32 including the two equal nonbinary targets. The factor is independent of ancestor depth; individual-field padding and unrestricted descriptor reparsing do not provide that guarantee.

The all-width reduction keeps the completed endpoint, cleanup, parking and charged-scan hypotheses explicit. Exact finite evidence covers 30 complete symbolic rectangles (153,354 rows), all 4,096 Boolean payloads on a 12-cell nonbinary-gap fixture, 64,000 volume comparisons, mixed-radix order and meaningful failure controls. PR2399 source bytes/Git blobs are pinned and credited; source/receipt corruption and Git-free public CLI tests pass under optimization.

Validation: native Windows CPython3.12.7 registered replay and optimized primary verifier; CPython3.14.5 normal primary and optimized six-group tests; metadata/source pins and whitespace checks. TEMP/TMP were redirected to writable workspace scratch for relocation tests.

Scope: conditional recursive-interface adapter, not an implemented fast callee, selected stock coefficient, supplier admission or new exponent. The reference callee uses indexed host memory; no physical tape-time claim, full selected cold replay, formal kernel, hosted CI or human review. Current main and predecessor were re-fetched unchanged before delivery; final live overlap will be recorded before publication.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit commdata2338/PR2399, Jose Manuel/PR2234, Adam Gall/PR2087 and the preserved supplier, source527, descriptor and parking lineage. Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
